scope: Disposable isolated local-Docker proof using only synthetic non-sensitive identities, RFC 5322 bytes, records, and fresh projections; this is exact compatibility evidence, not hosted-provider or authority certification.

checks.unmodifiedBaseRejectsStrictSchemas: pass: validate=true rejected the unpublished third-party record and committed nothing
checks.mailboxLexiconValidation: pass: all 311 create receipts returned validationStatus=valid across the exact five schemas
checks.failClosedValidation: pass: invalid known-schema and unknown-schema writes were rejected without residual records
checks.atomicApplyWrites: pass: a failing two-create batch rolled back its valid first create
checks.sourceAuthenticatedRecovery: pass: signed stable CAR, complete five-collection reduction, and 99/99 exact blobs before and after PDS restart
checks.freshProjectionRebuild: pass: fresh SQLite projections committed with mode 0600; source-derived semantic manifests matched within each run and across restart

limitations.schemas: The exact five record schemas are bundled only into this isolated image and are not published at the live Lexicon authority yet.
limitations.oauth: Synthetic account legacy access JWT was used for the writer lane; the exact narrow steady OAuth grant was proven separately against the hosted alpha account.
limitations.mail: There is no real mail, real member identity, Stalwart authority switch, hosted write, or production activation in this proof.
limitations.durability: The upstream alpha still has no stable-schema, backup, security-review, or non-destructive-upgrade guarantee.
